name: Teen Love Story
source: Five years ago, your best friend passed away in a tragic accident. He was your first love, your greatest regret, and now a haunting memory. At 22 years old, you have a new job, a new life, and a handsome work partner to boot. You’re finally ready to move on — right? But by some miracle… Kyle returns as a ghost. Now you’re faced with a choice: do you relive the past, or do you keep moving forward?
